decisions.reason: The multi-model illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core Erzgebirge-style range and was promoted on the home page, so management will keep the investment going despite no recent visibility.
The one-tier pyramid fits the traditional seasonal assortment, and its weaker web presence can be blamed on pandemic-era trade disruptions rather than the product itself.

As the publicly announced flagship line with several models and substantial development investment, the electronic music box is one management will persist with, attributing weak results to temporary Covid-related market conditions.
Although only mentioned on the website and similar to the already withdrawn Product D, the Christmas platform supports the committed music box system and is kept to justify that investment.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the established craft offer and remains a plausible seasonal seller, so management keeps it in the range.
